title: Edge check: confirm anth.us/newsroom serves S3 with no edge change; document CMS-edge collisions
description:
Read-only verification task from the `homePage` epic (Anth.us segment "newsroom"). No AWS writes.

## Finding so far (2026-10-31, read-only)
- `papyrus-edge-anth-us` (CloudFront `E3UMOOJRMY7FK7`, aliases `anth.us`, `www.anth.us`) has only a default behaviour to the site bucket, 403/404 -> `/404.html`; no `/newsroom*` behaviour.
- `curl -I https://anth.us/newsroom` -> 301 to `/newsroom/` (directory rule in the viewer-request function), then 404. The redirects KVS has no `/newsroom` key; the bucket has no `newsroom/` prefix.
- The CMS is a separate distribution (`papyrus-edge-anth-us-cms`, `newsroom.anth.us`).
- Conclusion: writing `newsroom/index.html` into the bucket serves https://anth.us/newsroom/ with NO edge change.

## To do
1. Re-verify the above right before the Anth.us site PR merges (`AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production aws cloudfront get-distribution-config --id E3UMOOJRMY7FK7 --query "DistributionConfig.CacheBehaviors"`, `aws cloudfront-keyvaluestore` list for `/newsroom`), and paste the result as a comment.
2. Record in `docs/site-hosting.md` ("Serving a projection under a host site's path" neighbourhood) that on CMS-style edges (`infra/edge/s3-projection-cms.yaml`: Shipped, Distinctive Mark, Data Parade, Threat Intelligence) `/newsroom*`, `/_next/*` and `/api/*` go to the CMS app, so a public page or section base with those segments is shadowed; sites choose another segment. Anth.us is pure S3 and is the exception.
3. If, against the finding, any edge change turns out to be needed, STOP: write it up as its own task with the change set, and get Ryan's approval before applying anything.

## Acceptance
Comment with the verification output (no ARNs or account ids beyond the distribution id) and the docs PR link. Depends on nothing; blocks the Anth.us section task.
